description: This file defines the NIT class within the WPEFramework::Broadcast::DVB namespace, representing a Network Information Table (NIT) used in DVB broadcasting. It includes nested classes for iterating over network entries and provides methods for accessing network descriptors and IDs.

classes.name: NIT
classes.description: Represents a DVB Network Information Table, providing access to network descriptors and network entries.

classes.name: NetworkIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing network entries within the NIT.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying NIT instances.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison between two NIT instances.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison between two NIT instances.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the NIT instance contains valid data.

methods.name: NetworkId
methods.description: Returns the network ID associated with the NIT.

methods.name: Descriptors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the descriptors in the NIT.

methods.name: Networks
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the network entries.

methods.name: DescriptorSize
methods.description: Private method to get the size of the descriptor section.
